product_metadata.title: Ronlap 3 Tier Slim Rolling Storage Cart, Skinny Rolling Cart with Wheels Slide Out Storage Organizer Mobile Shelving Unit Plastic Utility Carts for Bathroom Laundry Room Kitchen Narrow Place, White
features: 【Slim Storage Cart】: Dimensions is 26.2”x15.75”x5.1”, this 3 tier slim rolling storage cart is in proper size to fit in small spaces, great for use in your bathroom, laundry room, kitchen, bedroom, office, home, in-between your washer and dryer, or where you need some extra storage space

【Easy to Install】: This mobile shelving unit organizer is made of high-class plastic and stainless steel, durable and safe to withstand everyday use in your home for years. You can assemble this narrow rolling shelving unit organizer cart quickly and easily by clicking the parts together without any tools

【Slide Out Storage Organizer】: Four easy-glide durable wheels with 360°rotation and two of them with brakes, which make the skinny rolling storage organizer cart easy for you to slide out of any small space while effective to stop and prevent from moving on uneven floors

【Unique Designed Utility Cart】: The rolling utility cart with handle has high edges on all sides to keep everything in place. 4 pieces of moveable side hooks are convenient for hanging different small items. The adjustable middle section can be adjusted to 2 or 3 shelves for bathroom or kitchen countertop organizer without the wheels to meet your different storage needs. The mesh design at the bottom makes it available to clean by water directly

【Multi-Purpose Rolling Cart】: You can use this small plastic rolling cart with wheels in different ways, including as an extra work area in the kitchen, as laundry essentials storage cart between your washer and dryer, as fruit vegetable organizer outside the refrigerator, as practical rolling shelving unit in the hall or as a different utility cart with shelves in your bedroom
